ينفلت (form VII)

# يَنْفَلِتَ (yanfalita) /jan.fa.li.ta/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَلَتَ (infalata)
# يَنْفَلِتْ (yanfalit) /jan.fa.lit/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْفَلَتَ (infalata)
